mods.name: SchlechtLoewe
mods.description: Custom Client mit Cosmetics, Challenges und Performance-Features

releases.notes:
This version marks the very first foundation of the **SchlechtLoewe** Mod. It establishes a stable and functional base for future development, focusing on core structure, configuration handling, and modular design rather than visible in-game features.
The client successfully integrates with Fabric and builds without errors, providing a clean starting point for expanding functionality. A basic configuration system is included, automatically generating a config file and directory structure to support future features such as cosmetics, performance settings, and gameplay challenges.
Internally, the project already contains the groundwork for multiple systems, including a feature manager, keybinding support, and early cosmetic architecture. While these elements are not yet fully implemented or visible in-game, they are designed to allow scalable and organised development moving forward.
Version 0.1.0 is intended as a technical milestone rather than a feature-complete release. It ensures that the client runs reliably and that all core systems are prepared for the next stages, where graphical elements, gameplay features, and user interface components will be introduced.
